sec-idor-invoice.provenance: ai-assisted draft (Claude), self-reviewed; pending independent review

distractor_rationale.a: CSRF tricks a victim's browser into making requests; here the attacker uses their own session.
distractor_rationale.b: The id is typed as int and used through the ORM; nothing is concatenated into SQL.
distractor_rationale.d: Session fixation concerns how session ids are issued at login.

follow_up_questions: Should the API return 403 or 404 for an invoice the user does not own? Why?

distractor_rationale.b: The % operator formats the string in Python before the driver sees it.

sec-password-storage.provenance: ai-assisted draft (Claude), self-reviewed; pending independent review

distractor_rationale.a: Salts stop precomputed tables but SHA-256 is far too fast to resist guessing.
distractor_rationale.b: Encryption is reversible; a leaked key exposes all passwords.
distractor_rationale.d: MD5 is fast and broken; repetition and a pepper do not fix that.

follow_up_questions: How would you migrate existing SHA-256 hashes to Argon2id without forcing every user to reset?

sec-react-xss-bio.provenance: ai-assisted draft (Claude), self-reviewed; pending independent review

distractor_rationale.a: Deny-lists miss event-handler attributes and javascript: URLs.
distractor_rationale.c: HttpOnly protects one cookie; injected scripts can still act as the user.
distractor_rationale.d: CORS controls cross-origin reads, not scripts executing in your page.

follow_up_questions: What would a Content-Security-Policy add here, and what would it not fix?

sec-jwt-logout-all.provenance: ai-assisted draft (Claude), self-reviewed; pending independent review

distractor_rationale.b: The scenario says signing keys are not per user or rotated; that is also not how most systems work.
distractor_rationale.c: Longer expiry widens the window of misuse.
distractor_rationale.d: The stolen laptop still has its own copy of the token.

follow_up_questions: What does adding a per-user token version cost on every request, and how would you limit that cost?

sec-leaked-api-key.provenance: ai-assisted draft (Claude), self-reviewed; pending independent review

distractor_rationale.a: History rewrites do not affect copies that were already cloned or scraped.
distractor_rationale.b: Past exposure cannot be undone by changing visibility.
distractor_rationale.d: The key remains in history and may already be harvested.

follow_up_questions: How would you deploy a rotated key with no downtime?
